rocksndiamonds.title: Rocks'n'Diamonds

source.imported: Upstream tree imported into this repository at 83f44f2 (file for file the same as the upstream commit, which was also upstream's head on 3 November 2026); build-amiga.sh builds it as imported, with patches/ applied to a copy

rocksndiamonds.contentPolicy: Engine GPL-2.0 (Artsoft Entertainment, Holger Schemel; COPYING). Upstream's own data (graphics, sounds, the rhythm loop, the tutorials, the help texts) ships under the GPL-2.0 terms Arch's and upstream's own packages give it (Dale's decision, 3 November 2026); Debian treats its licence as unclear and leaves it out. The classic level sets (recreations of commercial games' levels) and the three demoscene music modules are never packed.
